title: Basilica concert
text: Beautiful setting on a quiet square.   The Basilica was recently renovated and is so beautiful.    The acoustics were amazing and the selection of pieces perfection.   Would go back anytime.    Joyous.
author: deniseaA1000MC

title: A wonderful concert...
text: A wonderful concert in a beautiful setting. It was absolutely worth it and a great contrast to the hustle and bustle in the city.
author: Regina_W

title: A Gem!
text: The musicians were incredibly talented and performed beautifully. We enjoyed the classical music that was familiar to us and it was exceptionally special being in such a grand and lovely basilica.
author: Heidi_C

title: Amazing experience
text: Amazing performance in a wonderful location.
author: richardaX5814MT

title: Incredible!
text: This show was amazing!  The acoustics in the basilica were incredible!  The singer sang beautifully and really added a lot to the performance. I would recommend paying extra for Zone A. It gets you up close and personal with the musicians. Zone B isn’t bad but I sat in the front row and am really glad we paid the extra to sit there.  It was truly incredible 😊
author: cindysY7652KY

title: A Beautiful Concert in a Beautiful Basilica
text: The concert was lovely. The Basilica was beautiful and had the best acoustics. All of the orchestra members worked together to give us a beautiful concert. It was a birthday gift from my friend, and she enjoyed it as well. She had bought tickets for the first five rows of the church so we could see very well. It was a great night!
author: elizabethcN5856FI

title: Excellent performance and atmosphere
text: A concert to see absolutely in Barcelona and an excellent performance. The atmosphere in the church was just wow! I was center right, 1st row. Kudos to the musicians and the singer.
author: Simonne_V
